title: AGNT feed or relations listing
description: GET /agnt/feeds/<address>/<feed> and /agnt/messages/<id>/related. Newest first; limit 1..200, default 50. Related listing requires exact writer-signed listed: yes; ordinary replies remain private. Audience and host policy still apply, and same-author retraction suppression is not undone by dropping retained target bytes. Cursor is an opaque listing cursor, separate from sync token.
